reading.title: Scorpio Sun with Venus-Mars Sextile
overview: The Sun stands at 18° Scorpio with the Moon at 25° Scorpio out of bounds and not void of course. Mercury is retrograde at 6° Scorpio while Venus is retrograde in its rulership at 23° Libra. Mars at 23° Leo conjoins Jupiter at 25° Leo, and Saturn at 9° Aries retrograde conjoins Neptune at 2° Aries retrograde.

Mundane tradition reads the Venus sextile Mars at 0.21° orb as a period when alliances and resources for defense move in measured coordination. The Moon square Jupiter at 0.35° orb and the Mars-Jupiter conjunction at 2.32° orb point to expansionist pressures that can exceed available means. Uranus trine Pluto at 1.12° orb and Neptune sextile Pluto at 1.3° orb describe slow structural shifts whose effects appear only over longer intervals.

The Sun square Mars at 5.44° orb and Mercury square Pluto at 3.15° orb add tension between leadership statements and underlying power contests. Saturn conjunction Neptune at 6.85° orb continues to color institutional boundaries with uncertainty. No national angles receive exact contacts beyond the listed transits within 2°.

nations.reading: Neptune opposes the Sibly MC at 1.04° while Jupiter opposes the natal Moon at 1.85° and Saturn sextiles natal Uranus at 0.15°. These contacts coincide with reporting on US-Qatar talks and Democratic Party commentary, though the fair-test records show no reliable link between such transits and daily events.

Pluto opposes the natal Moon at 1.14° and Uranus sextiles the natal Moon at 0.02°. Mars sextiles the ASC at 0.06° while squaring the natal Sun at 0.67°. The contacts align with Knesset orientation coverage, yet records find Mars afflictions no better than chance for rocket alerts.

Pluto conjoins natal Saturn at 1.69° and Neptune sextiles natal Saturn at 0.39°. Jupiter conjoins natal Jupiter at 0.66°. The positions sit with reports of energy infrastructure damage, though the tested Mars and lunation correlations remain within chance.

Saturn squares natal Sun at 0.62° and Uranus opposes natal Jupiter at 0.23°. Jupiter trines natal Mercury at 0.16°. These occur alongside election-market questions, with no demonstrated predictive edge over random expectation.

reading.lore_and_intel: Venus sextile Mars and Mars-Jupiter conjunction appear in coverage of Israeli parliamentary preparation and Ukrainian energy strikes, while Uranus trine Pluto and Neptune sextile Pluto coincide with Taiwan election markets and software reports; Mercury square Pluto overlaps US-Qatar negotiation items. The same aspects show no overlap with unrelated items such as African disinformation or South African detentions, and the fair-test results place all examined Mars, lunation and eclipse claims at chance levels.

watch.note: Mercury stations direct and Venus stations direct

reading.the_test: Records over thousands of days show Mars afflictions produce war-related alerts or losses no better than chance. Full moons and eclipses likewise yield earthquake and alert counts within random variation. The tested claims therefore supply no predictive improvement over baseline expectation.
